title: The Salt Bells
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Every full moon, the drowned bells of Salt Harbor ring under the water — and sixteen-year-old diver Maren hears them clearly when no one else can. When a boy is pulled from the sea wearing a bell around his neck, Maren must dive to the drowned chapel to return it.
short_description: Maren, a free-diver grieving her mother's disappearance, finds Finn, a half-drowned boy wearing a chapel bell.
long_description: Maren, a free-diver grieving her mother's disappearance, finds Finn, a half-drowned boy wearing a chapel bell. He is a Bell-Keeper who lost his memory. A great storm comes; Maren dives to the drowned chapel at full moon, rings the great bell, and becomes the new Bell-Keeper.
main_characters: Finn — mysterious, gentle, remembering in fragments
Granny Nessa — wise, knows the bells' story
